scope: Style and wartime scene studies of the same Bihac composition; no production background replaced or integrated.

variants.name: 8-bit arkadni
variants.exactPrompt: STYLE STUDY A — 8-BIT ARCADE TILE PIXEL ART. Use the supplied image ONLY as a map of the subject and composition, NEVER as a rendering-style reference. Redraw its Bihać scene from scratch as a deliberately chunky low-resolution 1980s arcade-game background. Recognizable subjects: the Una's small stepped cascades in the middle, a squat square stone Kapetanova kula with a steep dark four-sided roof right of center, a few ruined low tiled-roof houses, wooded hills behind, and an uninterrupted pale horizontal earth combat strip across the lowest 20% of the canvas. Keep the WWII setting without modern structures, people, text, fire or smoke. THIS MUST LOOK RADICALLY DIFFERENT FROM THE SOURCE: drawn on a tiny 256x170 pixel working grid, enlarged roughly 6 times with nearest-neighbor blocks. Uniform visibly square pixels, 16 deliberately chosen saturated but earthy colors total, thick dark 1-logical-pixel outlines around buildings, tile-like tree canopies and cliff clusters, flat color planes with at most two shades per material. Make rooftops, tower, water and clouds simple icon-like silhouettes. NO tiny masonry stones, no individual leaves, no realistic roof textures, no smooth gradients, no photographic light, no anti-aliasing or painterly shading. Use the angular economical visual language of an actual old arcade framebuffer, not a realistic illustration with a pixel filter. Preserve a calm light combat strip behind game units. One opaque landscape image about 3:2. No label or caption in the art.

variants.name: 16-bit bez obruba
variants.exactPrompt: STYLE STUDY B — COLORFUL 16-BIT CONSOLE PIXEL LANDSCAPE, NO OUTLINES. Treat the attached Bihać image ONLY as a subject/composition diagram; completely discard its realistic surfaces and lighting. Redesign the same view as a polished, visibly low-resolution hand-placed 1990s console game background: Una channels and small white cascades in the center, a square old stone tower with a steep hipped roof right of center, a handful of damaged red-roof houses, layered wooded hills, and the flat light earth gameplay strip along the bottom 20%. Strict logical drawing resolution 320x213, enlarged with visible 4–5px SQUARE steps; hard edges only. Around 28 purposeful colors, cool turquoise water, soft blue-violet distant ridges, autumn ochre and olive canopy clusters, warm pale plaster. Organic tree masses built from large interlocking pixel clusters rather than a tiled grid. Separate forms by adjacent COLOR blocks, with NO black cartoon contour lines. Shade each big surface using only 2–3 hard-edged tones. Use sparse ordered pixel dithering in a few shadow transitions, no gradients. Simplified roof planes and a few symbolic window pixels, NOT rows of miniature realistic tiles or masonry. Cloud shapes must be broad economical stacked pixel masses, not noisy photographic clouds. This is game scenery, NOT detailed concept art, watercolor, a 3D render, or a realistic painting pixelated afterward. The image should be clearly different from hard-outlined 8-bit tile art: richer gentle color harmonies and rounded organic pixel clusters, but still emphatically pixel art. WWII architectural setting only, no modern fixtures, figures, text, labels, smoke or flames. A single opaque 3:2 landscape.

variants.name: Četiri boje · handheld
variants.exactPrompt: STYLE STUDY C — FOUR-COLOR HANDHELD PIXEL WOODCUT. The attachment is ONLY the map of the subject and layout; discard ALL its textures, realistic shading and colors. Draw the same Bihać game scenery as if for an original monochrome handheld console: 160x106 LOGICAL PIXELS, massively enlarged to a landscape opaque canvas, extremely visible uniform square pixel steps. Use EXACTLY FOUR FLAT INK VALUES: very dark forest green, medium olive green, light sage green and pale warm yellow-green. No other colors or intermediate shades. Una water and small stepped cascades central; a squat square old tower with a simple pyramidal roof right of center, a few damaged village houses, rounded wooded hills behind, a completely flat unobstructed pale foreground strip occupying the lower fifth. Simplify the entire scene into bold readable silhouettes and economical symbolic shapes, with small 2x2 logical-pixel ordered dithering patterns in selected shadow patches like a coarse digital woodcut. A tower is a handful of large blocks, not hundreds of stones; trees are dark silhouette masses, not individually rendered leaves. Use dramatic dark/light figure-ground shapes and graphic hatching made only of square pixels; no atmospheric gradients, no watercolor, no glossy surfaces, no tiny realistic architectural detail, no anti-aliasing, no original photo-like cloud pattern. This must be unmistakably a very coarse four-tone retro framebuffer illustration, structurally distinct from both colored arcade tile art and rich 16-bit landscape painting. Keep historical WWII damage as simple broken roof silhouettes, with NO painted fire/smoke. No people, text, labels or borders. Do not produce an image of a handheld device; output only the game background.
